answer: Every claim must carry its scar: the filer writes one failure report — what went wrong and how it was fixed — on an opal slip, and files it with the claim. The Onyx desk reads the report within a day, checks the fix is visible in the finished work, and compares the report against the Ocean archive; a claim with no failure, or no fix, is rejected and forfeits a 250-coin bond, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 invented failures with matching fixes plus 250,000 coins in bonds. One operator blamed the same broken tool in forty claims, and the desk threw all forty out.
